entries.title: Bound remote agent mention authorization
entries.rationale: Accepted as targeted send-time authorization hardening. Preserve relay-signed membership scoped to viewer/destination/selected pubkeys, agent runtime/profile/policy proof, owner-only filtering, two fresh checks before side effects/publication, and fail-closed relay-only behavior.
security_reasons: send-time mention authorization is narrowed to the destination channel and selected pubkeys
relay membership, runtime directory, owner profile, and managed policy form a chained trust boundary
relay or revocation failures must not admit relay-only agents
authorization is rechecked before side effects and publication

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated mention authorization threat review, targeted channel/pubkey query tests, revocation and relay-error tests, dependency screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, targeted native command, channel-scoped relay filters, owner/policy chain, send-boundary integration, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
